# Eight lessons — Weeks13–14
Unit 4 full-course consolidation after Weeks 11–12 review; no additional project work. Year 12 Units 3–4 integrated, earlier foundations revisited where diagnosed. Typically 50–55 minutes per lesson; adapt to actual timetable.
Week 13 L1: 30 minutes for the optional self-check, 15 min criterion/evidence review, 5–10 min two priorities. L2: 5 min retrieval, 15 min Python/algorithm/OOP modelled repair, 25 min independent relevant tasks, 5–10 min exit. L3: 5 min retrieval, 15 min SQL/design repair, 25 min fresh seed tasks, 5–10 min feedback. L4: 5 min retrieval, 15 min network/security boundary comparison, 25 min case/address practice, 5–10 min explanation. Teacher uses these common clinics to establish prerequisites; not every long station is completed by every learner.
Week 14 L1: priority 1 clinic with teacher feedback and fresh independent attempt. L2: priority 2 clinic same pattern. L3: short mixed transfer(T6), peer/teacher evidence review, changed task; no marks or grading. L4: delayed priority retries, record demonstrated/needs retry/not yet evidenced, schedule small revision tasks for Weeks 15–16 and remaining support. A delayed retry uses a later lesson, not a promised homework deadline.
Teacher can reteach the common gap and assign extension to demonstrated learners. Each chosen station sequence: identify cause -> one worked step -> guided variation -> independent fresh variation -> explanation -> delayed retry. Pack tasks are a menu sampled to fit allocation, not compulsory extra homework. Avoid arbitrary grades/automated mastery thresholds.
Explained answers and reference code are openly downloadable for self-review. Visual course-symbol verification and actual learner work still need review. No real networks/personal data or operational system changes.
